items.t: Head gasket leaks
items.job: Replace both head gaskets and resurface heads
items.note: A timing belt and water pump are often replaced at the same time. Cost rises a lot if the engine overheated.

items.t: AWD binding in tight turns (automatic)
items.job: Replace AWD transfer (duty C) solenoid
items.note: If the transfer clutch pack itself is worn, expect much more.

items.t: Timing belt breaks and damages the engine
items.job: Replace timing belt, idlers and tensioner
items.note: If the belt already broke and bent the valves, cylinder head work adds well over $1,500.

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or slow to engage
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with used or rebuilt unit
items.note: Fluid service or a solenoid can fix milder cases for much less.

items.t: Engine bearing failure and knocking
items.job: Replace engine with used or remanufactured unit
items.note: A low-mileage used engine is the cheaper route.

items.t: Turbocharger failure from oil starvation
items.job: Replace turbocharger and oil feed line
items.note: Cost rises a lot if oil starvation also damaged the engine bearings.

items.t: CVT shudder, jerking or failure
items.job: Replace CVT valve body and refill fluid
items.note: Subaru extended CVT coverage on these years; it may have ended for your car. A complete CVT replacement costs far more.

items.t: Excessive oil consumption
items.job: Replace engine short block (piston ring fix)
items.note: The settlement coverage has likely ended. Many owners just keep the oil topped off.

items.t: Battery drains while parked
items.job: Test for parasitic drain and replace battery
items.note: Finding a module that will not go to sleep can take extra diagnosis time.

items.t: Thermo control valve fault
items.job: Replace thermo control valve and refill coolant
items.note: Covered by Subaru's 15-year/150,000-mile extension on this valve. Check the VIN with a dealer.

items.t: Windshield cracks with no clear impact
items.job: Replace windshield and recalibrate EyeSight cameras
items.note: A settlement extended coverage on some cars; glass coverage on your insurance may also help.

items.t: Touchscreen freezes, blanks or reboots
items.job: Update head unit software; replace head unit if needed
items.note: Most cars need only the software update. A replacement head unit is the high end.

items.t: Passenger airbag stays off for a lighter adult
items.job: Diagnose and recalibrate passenger occupant sensor
items.note: A new sensor is the high end if a fault is found.

items.t: EyeSight brakes hard for no reason
items.job: EyeSight diagnosis, recalibration and software update

items.t: Windshield chips and cracks from small stones
items.job: Replace windshield and recalibrate EyeSight cameras
items.note: Comprehensive insurance often covers glass.

items.t: Engine stalls on the highway and will not restart right away
items.job: Diagnose stalling (scan codes, fuel and ignition checks)
items.note: Repair cost depends on what is found; a new car should be covered under warranty.

items.t: Exhaust smell in the cabin or smoke from the tailpipe
items.job: Repair exhaust manifold leak
items.note: A new car should be covered under warranty.

items.t: Takata passenger airbag inflator (recall)
items.job: Replace passenger airbag inflator
items.note: Free under the Takata recalls (such as 15V-323 and 18V-012). Check the VIN first.

items.t: Brake lines can rust through (recall)
items.job: Replace rusted brake lines and bleed brakes
items.note: Free under recalls 13V-110 and 14V-311. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Secondary air pump relay can stick on (recall)
items.job: Replace secondary air pump relay
items.note: Free under recall 16V-738. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Ignition switch can shut the engine off (recall)
items.job: Replace ignition switch
items.note: Free under recall 19V-297. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Wiper motor cover can overheat and melt (recall)
items.job: Replace wiper motor cover assembly
items.note: Free under recall 16V-694. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Electronic parking brake may not hold (manual transmission, recall)
items.job: Electronic parking brake repair
items.note: Free under recall 18V-626. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Transmission oil can leak onto exhaust (recall)
items.job: Replace transmission seal cap and top up fluid
items.note: Free under recall 15V-502. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering column may be machined wrong (do-not-drive recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace steering column
items.note: Free under recall 16V-292. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Knee airbag bracket may not be attached (recall)
items.job: Inspect and secure knee guard bracket
items.note: Free under recall 16V-716. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Low-pressure fuel pump may fail (recall)
items.job: Replace in-tank low-pressure fuel pump
items.note: Free under recall 21V-587 / 20V-218. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Low-fuel warning may read wrong (recall)
items.job: Reprogram instrument cluster software
items.note: Free under recall 18V-773. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Body spot welds may be missing (recall)
items.job: Inspect body welds
items.note: Free under recall 19V-493. Check the VIN first.

items.t: CVT drive chain can slip and break (recall)
items.job: Reprogram CVT control software
items.note: Free under recall 21V-955 / 22V-485. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Passenger occupant sensor may shut off airbag (recall)
items.job: Replace passenger seat occupant sensors
items.note: Free under recall 24V-227. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Water in inhibitor switch disables reverse lights and camera (recall)
items.job: Replace transmission inhibitor switch
items.note: Free under recall 23V-755. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Driveshaft center support bolts can loosen (recall)
items.job: Fit new driveshaft center support bolts
items.note: Free under recall 23V-647. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front coil springs can rust and break (recall)
items.job: Replace front coil springs
items.note: Free under recall 01V-216. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear subframe can rust and break (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace rear subframe
items.note: Free under recall 03V-153. Check the VIN first.
